column1: # host: Windows 11 (shared with other sessions; rows vary run to run), stock JDK 21.0.9 + patched java.base (--patch-module); M3HashAtomsPerf: static final MethodHandles bound to the function (invokeExact), corpus 2048 random inputs of length 0..1100, 40 passes per round, warm-up 6, best of 7
# committed-N: M3ByteArrayAccess over jdk.internal.util.ByteArrayLittleEndian (this change), three runs (committed-3: tools/gate.sh)
# alternative-internal-unsafe: the same rows with M3ByteArrayAccess over jdk.internal.misc.Unsafe getLong/getInt/getShort (NOT committed; isolates the cost of the access)
# speedup = vendored ns/op / absorbed ns/op (above 1: absorbed faster)

# columns since the JIT leaf: median and best of the measured rounds (interleaved A/B), rounds, mean system CPU load; the earlier runs (6-column table) carried over: their single value was the best of 7 rounds

# <variant>-clean-<path>: one JVM per M3HashAtomsPerf row group (bytes, xxh3-64, xxh3-128, string, bytebuffer, access+kernel); <variant>-clean-all: every group in one JVM (shared kernels see every input kind); variants: before = base 32f8e561b29, split = XXH3_SPLIT v1 only, after = this change (XXH3_SPLIT v1 + UNSAFE_TO_BYTE_ARRAY v2 + FACADE_ENTRY_CHECK v1); tools/jit_gate.sh

# diag-<d>-r<n>, diag3-<d>-r<n>: diagnostic builds on top of the split (scratch, NOT committed), two repetitions: d1 = every byte[] read through jdk.internal.misc.Unsafe behind its own Preconditions.checkIndex (ByteArrayLittleEndian's check), d2 = the same reads unchecked, d3 = a checked and an unchecked instance chosen by a final field per read
# after-gate-all: the perf step of tools/gate.sh on this change (every group in one JVM)
